Stopping condition: Stop after all requested product metadata, the All Reviews summary, system headings, and corresponding minimum Storage requirements have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use All Reviews rather than Recent Reviews and preserve the displayed label, percentage, and review count.
- Use only operating-system headings shown under System Requirements and do not infer support from the language table.
- If multiple operating systems show the same Storage value, report the value for each heading rather than collapsing them.
- Do not sign in, add the product to an account, wishlist, or cart, or begin a purchase.

Findings from the Steam page for Portal 2 (https://store.steampowered.com/app/620/Portal_2/):

Product metadata
- Title: Portal 2
- Release Date: 19 Apr, 2011
- Developer: Valve
- Publisher: Valve

All Reviews summary
- The page segment with the All Reviews rollup is not exposed in the current visible DOM snapshot. Only the separate links
  - "RECENT REVIEWS: Overwhelmingly Positive (1,899)" and
  - "ENGLISH REVIEWS: Overwhelmingly Positive (173,486)"
  are available, and no combined "All Reviews" label, percentage, or total review count is present in the accessible evidence. Because that specific All Reviews summary text is not visible to the browser agent, I cannot reliably report it without guessing.

System Requirements
Operating‑system headings under System Requirements (as shown on the page):
1) Windows
2) SteamOS + Linux

Verified minimum Storage requirements
- Windows (Minimum): 8 GB available space
- SteamOS + Linux (Minimum): 8 GB available space

Notes on evidence
- The Release Date, Developer, and Publisher fields are taken directly from the Portal 2 title block on the Steam page.
- The System Requirements section clearly shows the two OS tabs: "Windows" and "SteamOS + Linux".
- Within the minimum specs under the SteamOS + Linux tab, the Storage line is: "Storage: 8 GB available space". This matches the minimum Windows storage requirement as well, but per the task constraints it is reported separately for each OS heading.
- The All Reviews rollup text (including label, percentage, and total review count) is not present in the agent-visible DOM, so it cannot be reported without violating the requirement to preserve the displayed wording and numbers exactly.
